description: Root governance for the Aeostara authority/specification repository. This policy is platform-agnostic and language-agnostic. It defines behavioral constraints that all platform implementations must satisfy.

rules.name: Platform Agnosticism
rules.description: Root specifications must not prescribe platform-specific toolchains, languages, build systems, or runtime dependencies. Platform choices belong to platform implementation repositories.

rules.name: Language Agnosticism
rules.description: Root specifications define behavior in pseudo code, JSON Schema, and natural-language contracts. They must not mandate any specific implementation language.

rules.name: Behavior Authority
rules.description: Root specifications are the authoritative source for what each platform implementation must do. Contracts, algorithms, and interfaces defined here are binding on all platform implementations.

rules.name: Native-Only Shipped Product
rules.description: All shipped product paths must compile to native binaries. No interpreted runtime (Python, Node.js, etc.) is permitted in the shipped product. This constraint applies to all platform implementations.

rules.name: No Python in Shipped Product
rules.description: Python is permitted only for repository automation (CI scripts, schema validation, acceptance runners). Python must never appear in a shipped product path.

rules.name: No YAML in Shipped Product
rules.description: No YAML parser may exist in the shipped product. Configuration is JSON-only for v0.1. YAML is permitted only in CI/automation tooling.

rules.name: Deterministic Behavior
rules.description: No random production behavior. All repair plans are deterministic. Same input must produce same output across all platform implementations.

rules.name: Core Behavior Constraints
rules.description: Policy gating, backup, verification, rollback, and audit are mandatory behavioral constraints. Every platform implementation must implement these behaviors as defined by the root specifications.

rules.name: No Mutation Without Rollback
rules.description: Every file mutation must be preceded by a backup. Rollback must be available for every repair action. This is a cross-platform behavioral requirement.

rules.name: Proprietary Licensing
rules.description: All files carry proprietary copyright header. Copyright (c) 2026 James Daley. All Rights Reserved.

rules.name: No Implementation Code in Root
rules.description: The root/main branch must not contain compilable source code or platform-specific build system configurations. Root contains only specifications, contracts, algorithms, interfaces, acceptance targets, compliance rules, fixtures, CI automation, and planning artifacts.

root_repo_contains: specs/acceptance/ — Shared acceptance targets and compliance checklists
ci/ — Repository automation (schema validation, acceptance running, compliance checking)
root_repo_does_not_contain: Compilable source code in any language
